requirement.description: The tags_or_list validator incorrectly rejects valid tag list inputs. When a list is passed containing tag dictionaries with "Key" and "Value" fields, it should be accepted as valid input for Tags properties.
requirement.contract: Modify the tags_or_list validator to accept valid tag list structures. A list of dictionaries with "Key" and "Value" fields should be considered valid input for Tags properties, while still rejecting invalid inputs like strings or other non-tag structures.
requirement.acceptance: Tests should pass for: 1. tags_or_list(Tags()) - existing functionality 2. tags_or_list([]) - accept empty tag lists 3. tags_or_list([{"Key": "foo", "Value": "bar"}]) - accept valid tag list 4. tags_or_list({"Items": [...]}) - existing functionality for Items structure 5. tags_or_list("invalid") - still reject invalid inputs like strings

requirement.description: The Tags class constructor does not properly handle list inputs for tag creation. When a list of tag dictionaries is passed, it should be processed correctly instead of raising TypeError.
requirement.contract: Enhance the Tags class constructor to accept list inputs. When a list is provided as an argument, each item should be validated as a tag dictionary (containing "Key" and "Value" fields) and converted to the internal representation. This should support the standard AWS tag format.
requirement.acceptance: Tests should pass for: 1. Tags({"foo": "bar"}) - existing functionality 2. Tags([{"Key": "foo", "Value": "bar"}]) - new functionality to accept tag lists 3. Tags(foo="bar") - existing functionality 4. Tags([{"Key": "foo", "Value": "bar"}, {"Key": "baz", "Value": "qux"}]) - new functionality for multiple tags

requirement.description: The Batch JobDefinition resource's Tags property validation rejects valid tag list inputs, causing test failures.
requirement.contract: Update the validation for the Tags property in the Batch resource to accept valid tag list structures as inputs.
requirement.acceptance: Test case should pass: JobDefinition("myjobdef", Type="container", ContainerProperties=ContainerProperties(Image="image", Vcpus=2, Memory=2000, Command=["echo", "foobar"]), Tags=[{"Key": "foo", "Value": "bar"}])

requirement.description: The DynamoDB Table resource's Tags property validation rejects valid tag list inputs, causing test failures.
requirement.contract: Update the validation for the Tags property in the DynamoDB Table resource to accept valid tag list structures as inputs.
requirement.acceptance: Test case should pass: Table("mytable", KeySchema=[KeySchema(KeyType="HASH", AttributeName="id")], BillingMode="PAY_PER_REQUEST", Tags=[{"Key": "Name", "Value": "Example"}])

requirement.description: The CloudFront AnycastIpList resource's Tags property validation is overly restrictive and rejects valid tag list inputs.
requirement.contract: Update the validation for the Tags property in the CloudFront AnycastIpList resource to accept valid tag list structures in addition to the existing Items structure.
requirement.acceptance: Test case should pass: AnycastIpList("AnycastIpList", IpCount=1, Name="test", Tags=[{"Key": "bar", "Value": "bar"}, {"Key": "baz", "Value": "baz"}])
